notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
Update 1.01

[b]New features[/b]

Added a glossary section which provides information about the different “Old Folks” and doctor enemies.
Added a “Damage Dealt” stat to “Old Folk” towers and a “Money Earned” stat to the bake sale stall.
Tweaked the way the bake sale stall earns money. Now it earns a maximum of $6 per wave and earns consistent money, instead of earning a little at the start of the game and a lot at the end.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

Fixed bug: Next wave button stopped working after leaving a level part way through a wave and starting a new level again.
(Thank you to Aneoid for discovering and reporting this bug!

Thanks to everyone trying the game, we hope it is fun for you and let us know in our discord if you have any ideas, feedback or notice any bugs.
